method: Round 4 valid measurement: full-length TTS vocals mixed over a synthetic music bed with known per-word onsets (tempo + length variants). Score LRCLIB-style prior and generate-words output against the TTS truth JSON. Round 3 Deezer-preview / CTC-self scores are retained only as invalidated history.

round2_snap_only.reason: Snapping LRCLIB word priors left dense-rap residuals ~100–600 ms.

round3_deezer_preview_self_score.reason: ~30 s Deezer previews with guessed text anchors; 'truth' was CTC scored against itself (circular). BDKMV word-start p90 ~1.2–1.35 s with 46–53% coverage is not valid evidence.

round4_synth_full.note: Independent TTS onset truth. generate-words run with --no-demucs on the TTS+bed mix.
round4_synth_full.verdict: Aligner does not reach p90 ≲ 150 ms on valid synthetic truth; generate-words regresses vs the coarse LRCLIB-style prior on these fixtures. Ship quality gate + client fixes; keep DROME_LYRICS_ALIGN=false by default.

client_round4: seekSnapToken clears snapPending asynchronously so same-line snaps do not suppress the next line animation
nudge stores stamp fingerprint (first ~8 line starts + drome-aligned marker); reset only when stamp changes; migrate old entries once
NowPlaying 'Playing from' header: minimumScaleFactor 0.7 + dynamicTypeSize cap xxxLarge (no fixed height 16)
swift_ci: ios/LyricsTiming on Mac/Xcode — not run on this Linux agent VM
